rows.relative_change_definition: lambda(8)/lambda(2)-1; null unless both thresholds are uncensored

independent_checks.near_gamma_validation_note: Eight full-sparse retry minima remain Gamma-censored. Dense/sparse agreement is quantified at a separate 1e-6 relative tolerance because of near-Gamma conditioning; all discrepancies are below this tolerance, the threshold statistics exclude these values, and substituting the dense roots preserves every class.

protocol.pdonly: All 8^3 symmetry/time-reversal representatives including optical Gamma; six lowest non-Gamma grid seeds, fixed baseline Bloch and small-k LE seeds; Nelder-Mead maxiter 220; exclusion .00625, censor .00675; additional acoustic-direction checks
protocol.controls: All 4^3 representatives; two lowest non-Gamma grid seeds; Nelder-Mead maxiter 90; exclusion .025, censor .027; baseline LE search
protocol.arithmetic: Same full Kirchhoff-Hermite FE matrices. Exact load-dependent spectral elimination of strut-interior DOFs for Bloch first roots; dense full internal spectral Schur for PD and LE. Full sparse eigenproblem independently checks three fixed wavevectors and the final minimizing wavevector at every net/mesh. Rows using the full sparse generalized eigenproblem are validated against full dense roots and listed in verification.independent_checks.full_sparse_rows.
protocol.threshold_units: lambda = p/E_s = initial hydrostatic p0 times proportional load factor; E_s=1
protocol.censor: PD and LE null when at optical Gamma within 2e-6; micro null in the specified near-Gamma censor region. Raw bounds and sampled micro upper bounds are separate diagnostics, never substituted into threshold statistics.
protocol.limitations: Grid plus local refinement is a numerical search, not an interval-certified global minimum. Only r/l=.02 and this fixed 138-net cohort are checked.
